## Code Comments (with Resolutions)
- [docs/reference/container-images.md:309] **Stale description of script's file location**

This sentence says the script reads `upper-constraints.txt` "from the current directory", which was accurate for the original implementation but is no longer correct. The script now resolves `CONSTRAINTS="releases/${RELEASE}/upper-constraints.txt"` (line 16 of the script), so the file read is at `releases/<release>/upper-constraints.txt` relative to the current working directory — not directly at `./upper-constraints.txt`.

```suggestion
The script reads `releases/<release>/upper-constraints.txt` relative to the current working
directory (must be invoked from the repository root) and modifies it in-place. It uses GNU
`sed -i` for modifications (default on Ubuntu/CI runners — BSD `sed` is not supported).
```

- [images/python-base/Dockerfile:17] **`tzdata` install may prompt without `DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive`**

`tzdata` is known to present interactive prompts for geographic area and timezone when installed via `apt-get` if `DEBIAN_FRONTEND` is not set. Docker builds have no TTY, so `tzdata` usually defaults to UTC without hanging, but the behaviour is environment-dependent and has caused silent build failures on some CI runners. Setting `DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive` for the duration of this `RUN` step makes the behaviour explicit and portable.

```suggestion
RUN DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    ca-certificates \
    netbase \
    python3 \
    sudo \
    tzdata \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
```
